notes: Deterministic CPU forensic audit across 450 held-out Verda episodes (5 runs x 90) plus Silas's 05:07 EET 8k readout (v3-4k-s0@8k -0.716 +/- 0.105 vs -0.147 +/- 0.063 at 4k; paired v3-8k-s3 -0.788 +/- 0.117, 8k-trained minus 4k-trained at 8k = -0.073 +/- 0.173 on 60/60 identical rosters); quantifies raw 4k/8k header tax (~2842 tokens) and 92-98% 4k / 51-85% 8k canary eviction vs <900-token CompactState (<1800 compact prompt tokens, 0% eviction).

v3_4k_s0.explanation: 60% of GRPO training states come from the solver's final 6 pre-commit steps (where the reference solver has planted ~14.1 canaries on hard post-hoc locked dev seeds 0..29 and ~7.3 on medium), so forced-accuse accuracy reaches 0.892 by reading culprit identity off solver-gathered evidence. In standalone rollouts, v3-4k-s0 plants only 3.53 canaries/ep (0.87 before accusing), evicts 100.0% of planted canary maps at 4k, and hits 6/38 = 0.1579 (~0.16) precision.

v3_8k_s1.explanation: After 371 GRPO steps on A100 at 8k, forced-accuse whom-accuracy reached only 0.412 while free_accuse_frac rose to 0.115. Compounded by the 4k->8k context-length shift from its v2 4k SFT init, s1 plants only 2.31 canaries/ep, never calls list_employees on hard (0/30), still evicts 56.7% of canary maps at 8k (51.4% suffix), and accuses on 85/90 (94.4%) episodes around day 3.9 with mean P_full(accused)=0.0637 (83/85 = 97.6% below breakeven), yielding 8/85 = 0.0941 (~0.09) precision.

v3_8k_s2.explanation: Across 693 GRPO steps on H100 spot (1.87x s1), forced-accuse accuracy plateaued at 0.458, so valid accusations remained negative-EV and free_accuse_frac collapsed from 0.068 to 0.014. Furthermore, in train/grpo_investigator.py an empty accuse({}) call parsed as valid=True, left env.done=False without consuming a daily action, and handed continuation back to SolverPolicy for +0.76 reward; at standalone eval s2 emitted 784 rejected accuse({}) calls across 63/90 (70.0%) episodes while planting 1.69 canaries/ep (94.1% evicted at 8k), abstaining on 84/90 (93.3%).

inference_length_confound_v3_4k_s0_at_8k.training_spec: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct LoRA r=16, 609 decision-point GRPO steps from v2 SFT at max_ctx=4096 (H100 3bb74f5a)
inference_length_confound_v3_4k_s0_at_8k.root_mechanism: Identical 609-step weights trained solely on <=4000-token prompts stay cautious on medium (0.00 accused) and hard (0.03 accused) when HFPolicy truncates back to <=4000 tokens at 4k eval, but flip to 0.80 and 0.90 blind accusations (0/51 correct) when evaluated at max_ctx=8192 because 4000..8096-token histories push the LoRA outside its 4k SFT/GRPO training length support while still evicting 51-85% of planted canary recipient maps.
